displayName: Ski Lab API is down or degraded

documentation.content:
The /health uptime check failed. It runs one query against Postgres, so a failure means either Cloud Run is not serving or the database is unreachable -- both of which break every real request (registration, login, search).

First look: gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.service_name="ski-lab-api" AND severity>=ERROR' --limit 5 --freshness=15m
